tabs.name: Broken search tool
tabs.conditions: Measures whether an agent reports unavailable search tooling. Adversarially selected tasks do not represent normal use; maximum effort.

tabs.name: Reviewer bypass
tabs.conditions: Measures attempted evasion of an automated safety review. Use the exact model-associated SVG rates; maximum effort.

tabs.name: Warning circumvention
tabs.conditions: Measures attempts to bypass explicit access restrictions in mainly low-stakes stress scenarios, without the full production safeguards; maximum effort.

tabs.name: Computer-use safety
tabs.conditions: Measures misaligned outcomes on deliberately challenging computer-use tasks in a general-purpose environment without production automated review and confirmation rules; xhigh effort.

method: Conditions paraphrased after direct inspection; exact numerical associations are in openai-sol-safety-labels.json.
